methods.clock: Actual per-sample phase/turn delta observed independently of texture bag; phase integration checked against requested-state period.
methods.variation: 512point phase-normalized linear PCM waveform correlation, normalized adjacent-cycle RMS innovation, cycle RMS variation. Matched genuine raw pool statistics use all original adjacent cycles, never added noise.
methods.acf: Mean-removed correlation at one exact requested-interval lag over300ms, at8s forhighholds/1s others. No universal engine-ACF acceptance threshold.
methods.spectra: 65536point Hann FFT(.7324Hzresolution); order distributions integrate±.3ofintervalclock aroundorders1–64, retaining modulation sidebands. No inferred crank RPM.
methods.seams: 256sample phase-wrap windows(~5.33ms), maximum sample step, derivative RMS and6–20kHz spectral fraction; not listening or click certification.

limitations: Finite pools, phrase rearrangement and within-cycle morphing are authored approximations, not recovered native granular playback or new recorded sustain.
Sparse low-state pools may remain nearly periodic; authentic Bati exhaust is strongly periodic. No artificial variation is added to force an ACF score.
Waveform/cycle correlation depends on phase normalization and native interpolation; spectral and innovation descriptors do not establish recognizability or perceptual success.
During changing operating state a phase-continuous outgoing texture cycle can temporarily differ by more than5percent from the moving target; transition measurements report this explicitly.
The narrow transient-risk screen cannot prove absence of every embedded event; native event/ECU conditions remain unknown.
No endpoint, listening, spatial render, normalization or prior-audition write occurred.
